task: Create a 3D-ready dark fantasy wanderer's robe for a male game character, modelled ON the character standing in a T-POSE (arms straight out to the sides, horizontal, palms down). Render 5 orthographic reference views of the robe alone (no body, no head, no hands, no mannequin, no hanger), keeping the exact shape it has when worn in the T-pose.
reference_picture: the attached robe picture / earlier robe model: keep its look (layered capelet, soft cowl, hood down on the back, long open cloak with ragged tattered hem, iron clasp at the throat, rust-brown worn edges) but re-shape it for the T-pose
style: stylised 3D animated film look matching a stylised game character, clean 3D render, soft even studio lighting, plain white background, no floor shadow, whole garment in frame, identical scale and position in every view
worn_by: an invisible athletic stylised male body with broad shoulders, 173 cm tall, in a T-pose: arms horizontal at shoulder height (139 cm above the floor), each arm about 57.0 cm long from the shoulder joint to the fingertips
t_pose_shape: the capelet and the cloak's shoulders drape OVER the horizontal arms like a tent: the cloth rests on top of the upper arms and hangs down from them, it does not cut through the arms
the capelet reaches along the upper arm to about the elbow and hangs straight down from there; nothing wraps around the forearms or hands
under each arm the cloth hangs down from the arm, leaving a clear open gap at the armpit; no cloth stretched between the arm and the body
keep a gap of 1-2 cm between the cloth and the body / arms everywhere (the cloth never touches or crosses the skin)
below the arms the cloak hangs straight down with gravity, open at the front

design.materials: heavy brushed wool felt, near black (#1b1714) with rust-brown wear (#5a3420) along edges and folds, faint fibre texture; a small iron clasp and leather lacing at the throat
design.cowl: soft loose cowl round the neck base, sits on the shoulders, does not cover the chin
design.hood: deep hood worn DOWN, lying folded on the upper back between the shoulder blades (fits a head about 25.3 cm tall when raised)
design.capelet: two-layer capelet with a V-point at the front centre and ragged fringed edges, draped over the shoulders and upper arms as described above
design.cloak: long cloak from the shoulders, open at the front from the throat down (15-20 cm gap at the chest, widening to the hem), side slits from the armpit to the hem so the legs and arms move freely; hem at the lower calf, 22.5 cm above the floor, cut in jagged tatters
design.inside: room for a fitted tank top and shorts underneath: at least 1.5 cm over the chest (chest girth 82.6 cm), the bust/pecs and the shoulder blades
design.holes: wear holes and burns only painted on the surface, not cut through

construction_for_3d: single-layer cloth with a little thickness (0.3-0.5 cm), every part a clean closed surface, no floating pieces
layers (cowl, capelet, cloak) separated by at least 0.5 cm and never passing through each other
even, fine triangles: edge length about 1 cm or less, especially over the chest, back and shoulders (large flat triangles let the body show through)
no belts, straps, gloves, boots, trousers or body inside
UV-mapped with one colour texture, one normal map and one roughness map

views.name: front
views.description: straight front view, orthographic, centred, arms of the T-pose to the left and right

views.name: back
views.description: straight back view, orthographic, centred, showing the lowered hood

views.name: side
views.description: straight left side view, orthographic, front facing left

views.name: top
views.description: straight top-down view, orthographic, onto the shoulders, arms and neck opening

views.name: bottom
views.description: straight bottom-up view, orthographic, into the robe from below, showing the open front, the slits, the armpit gaps and the empty inside

output: 5 separate images (front, back, side, top, bottom): 1536x1024 landscape for front/back/top/bottom (the T-pose is wide), 1024x1536 portrait for side; same garment, same colours, same scale
